purpose: pytest coverage for argparse defaults and main() routing. It verifies local/non-privileged server defaults, stdout mode, missing-file usage errors, and dispatch to the injected server/stdout functions.
invariants: main() rejects missing files before dispatching to output/server code.
Tests monkeypatch run_stdout/run_tcp_server so no playback loop or socket server starts.
gotchas: argparse usage errors are represented as SystemExit in direct main() tests.
